description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). NUM(n LONG) 1 to 1024 by doubling; W(ID LONG primary key, N LONG indexed, s LONG, pad TEXT(200)) filled by INSERT INTO W SELECT (n * 389) Mod 1024, n Mod 7, n, String(200, 'x') FROM NUM WHERE n <= 700 ORDER BY n (700 rows on many pages; s is the insertion ordinal, ID a permutation of it). Dynasets of SELECT ID, s FROM W; ... WHERE s Mod 3 = 0; ... WHERE N = 2; ... WHERE N >= 5; snapshots of the same four, each read by GetRows(1000). Asks whether the round-1 rule holds across pages and past the 500-row population chunk.
